description: The owner serves without taking the lock, so two copies of the server run (OneOwner)
A 2025 question, which names no call, shows in a session that may not be its caller
The idle timer counts only the session whose quiet armed it, so another session's call is cut
The owner sends ready before it listens, so a client connects before any owner serves (ReadyMeansServing)
The session ignores EOF on its ready pipe and keeps waiting (WaitEnds)
